beats.summary: Meredith and Michael reconcile after the car accident, with Meredith forgiving Michael.

evidence.snippet: Meredith: I'm in because you hit me with your car. But I wanted to say, I heard you were trying really hard, so I'm not mad at you anymore.
Michael: Thanks, I'm not mad at you anymore.

beats.summary: Michael suggests Meredith might have been drunk when hit by his car, causing discomfort among coworkers.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Did you ever think of this? Would a sober person walk in front of a car?
Jim: I'm sorry, are you saying that Meredith was drunk at 9 AM?

beats.summary: Meredith denies being drunk, explaining Kahlua is just a kind of coffee.

evidence.snippet: Meredith: Drunk? No! You can't get drunk off Kahlua. It's just a kind of coffee.

beats.summary: Michael and coworkers share memories and say goodbye to Meredith during her hospital stay.

evidence.snippet: Michael: You know what, why don't go around the room and say one memory of Meredith.
Angela: Bye, Meredith. Here you go. We got you some balloons.

beats.summary: Michael believes the office is cursed after Meredith's accident and discusses possible causes with coworkers.

evidence.snippet: Michael: This office is cursed. And we need to do something about it.
Michael: That was the curse, Stanley, and we are trying to find the cause of the curse.

beats.summary: Michael receives medical care for dehydration and reflects on his hospital stay and insurance coverage.

evidence.snippet: Pediatrician: You're gonna be just fine, Michael! You're gonna have a good life.
Michael: Well, apparently, my insurance will not be covEring this hospital stay. I will be paying out-of-pocket.
